description: React component for the Validation Page, handling submission validation, quality gates, and displaying validation reports.

methods.name: loadSubmission
methods.description: Loads submission data and associated validation report based on submission ID.

methods.name: triggerValidation
methods.description: Triggers validation for the current submission ID and updates the report.

methods.name: runQualityGatesCompat
methods.description: Runs compatibility quality gates for the current submission ID.
